description: Republican candidates Owen Weaver (Senate 14th) and Ray Collins (State Representative 117th) today called on Governor Ned Lamont to convene a special session of the General Assembly so lawmakers can take immediate action on the installation and operation of automated license plate readers (ALPRs) across Connecticut.

title: Weaver and Collins Call for Immediate Action. Not a Pause, on Surveillance Cameras
